normalized_cue.text: Your delay is 2. We will now start practice for a delay of 2. For blocks with a delay of 2 , please respond mismatch for the first two trials . Keep your index finger on the comma key (,) and your middle finger on the period key (.) Please match the current letter to the letter that appeared 2 trials ago.
